description: Runs one EchoCall tool by its name, also one that is not in this list, with the same permissions, limits and logs as calling it directly. Find the name and the arguments with search_tools first. The rules of that tool apply: a tool whose description starts with COSTS MONEY or IRREVERSIBLE first answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat run_tool with the same arguments plus that value as arguments.confirm.

arguments.description: The arguments of that tool, as its input schema describes them. Leave out for a tool without arguments.

name.description: Name of the tool, exactly as search_tools returned it.

name: run_tool
title: Run an EchoCall tool
